name: Tavily MCP
tagline: Real-time web search, extract, map, and crawl via MCP — production-ready search capabilities for AI agents.
description: Tavily MCP Server provides production-ready web search and data extraction tools. Real-time search with tavily-search, intelligent data extraction via tavily-extract, website mapping with tavily-map, and systematic web crawling with tavily-crawl. Supports remote MCP server (no local installation) or local deployment. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP client. OAuth and API key authentication.
author: tavily-ai
